source.note: Used as architecture guidance only. Raphael remains a safety-gated companion cognition engine, not a generic autonomous agent.

patterns.raphaelUse: Turn pipeline decomposition
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Do not merge safety and reply generation into one opaque step.

patterns.raphaelUse: Safety, intent, mode, and host capability routing
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Safety routes override style and gameplay.

patterns.raphaelUse: Offline or gateway parallel critics
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No new frontend concurrency requirement.

patterns.raphaelUse: Candidate critique and revision
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Do not expose private reasoning or critic text to players.

patterns.raphaelUse: Backend and offline retrieval/eval tools
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No frontend API keys or live external tools.

patterns.raphaelUse: Response strategy and phase planning
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No autonomous player-dependent goals.

patterns.raphaelUse: Internal specialist critics and curators
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Do not expose multi-agent chatter to players.

patterns.raphaelUse: Session, relationship, preference, and reviewed long-term memory
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No automatic raw-player-input memory writes.

patterns.raphaelUse: Local preference learning and reviewed training data
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Global training requires consent, redaction, summarization, human review, and eval pass.

patterns.raphaelUse: Future standardized gateway connectors
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Gateway-side only unless separately approved.

patterns.raphaelUse: Measurable phase gates and maturity metrics
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Do not optimize for engagement dependency.

patterns.raphaelUse: Fallbacks for malformed, unsafe, ambiguous, or unsupported input
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Fail closed for safety and memory.

patterns.raphaelUse: Human approval for memory promotion, global training, and release
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No human-review bypass for sensitive changes.

patterns.raphaelUse: Approved canon and lore retrieval
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No public web search by default.

patterns.raphaelUse: Typed service-to-service contracts for future agents
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No unmanaged agent swarm.

patterns.raphaelUse: Latency, cost, fallback, and lightweight frontend policy
patterns.runtimeBoundary: NexusLink frontend must remain lightweight.

patterns.raphaelUse: Structured internal decision states and audit
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Do not reveal private reasoning.

patterns.raphaelUse: Layered safety, boundary, consent, output, and tool gates
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Safety beats every other goal.

patterns.raphaelUse: Regression suites, transcript labs, drift checks
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No main release without green gates.

patterns.raphaelUse: Explicit conflict ordering
patterns.runtimeBoundary: Gameplay rewards never outrank safety or boundaries.

patterns.raphaelUse: Offline generation of better fixtures and candidate strategies
patterns.runtimeBoundary: No autonomous live exploration on players.

recommendedNextPhase.goal: Compare current NexusLink Soul Talk output against external raphael-ai-engine advisory output without routing live player-facing output through the new engine.
